algorithm: DART model-based hand tracker bootstrapped by two learned neural priors (GloveNet ResNet-50 keypoint regressor; PointNet++-based keypoint network + JointNet FC mapping), online fingertip-vector kinematic retargeting solved via SLSQP (NLopt) warm-started each frame, Riemannian Motion Policies for arm motion generation
hand: Wonik Robotics Allegro hand (16-DoF, 4x4-joint fingers), retrofitted with 4 SynTouch BioTac tactile sensors at the fingertips
success_criterion: binary per-trial success/failure judged by whether the task's physical goal state was reached within the work volume; trial is a failure if the object falls out of the workspace volume (Table II caption)
headline_metric: per-task completion time and success rate over 5 consecutive trials, 2 pilots, 15 tasks
headline_value: completion times ranging from ~16s (Pick and Place: Brick) to ~358s (Container); NIST-task-board peg-in-hole insertion success rates typically within 10% (Sec. X, Limitations)
human_data: none in the deployed system (markerless, glove-free bare-hand vision tracking); a colored fabric glove was used only offline in a two-phase bootstrap to generate training annotations for the neural priors, ~100K point clouds from 7-8 hours of glove-tracked DART sessions
note_gaps: The kinematic-retargeting cost function's exact equation is an unrecovered image in the parsed markdown; only the surrounding prose defining its terms (beta, eta1, eta2, gamma, the S1/S2 vector sets, Table I) survived, so the precise algebraic form (which terms are squared-norm distance vs minimum-separation penalties) could not be verified.
operator_interface: four RealSense D415 RGB-D cameras tracking a bare hand, markerless; a coloured glove is worn only offline to train the neural hand-pose priors
retargeting_objective: minimise a weighted squared distance between human and Allegro fingertip task-space vectors, with switching weights that close primary-finger-to-thumb gaps and enforce a minimum finger separation, plus a regulariser toward the open hand, solved online with SLSQP
latency: about one second, end to end (Sec. IV)
